classification_policy.principle_conformance_definition: The normalized adapter preserves the method's defining embedding/decoding mechanism while benchmark-owned policy, RNG, masking, numerical pipeline, transport and metrics may differ by design.
classification_policy.note: Step 3.13 is an evidence-based discrepancy attribution over the frozen Step-3.12 pairs. It does not introduce post-hoc numerical pass/fail tolerances.

common: canonical P_reference and deterministic token ordering
normalized special-token policy excludes GPT-2 EOT but does not inject the author-only token-628 mask
token-ID decode is evaluated without author BPE-repair heuristics
fixed matched carrier length replaces historical sentence termination for this differential experiment
bins: partition is built over normalized V_allowed rather than the full author vocabulary
partition shuffle uses benchmark-owned MethodRandomSource instead of author global NumPy RNG
huffman: candidate set comes from canonical P_reference
exact tree-weight ties use deterministic (weight, min_token_id_in_subtree) ordering rather than author heap behavior
arithmetic: temperature is applied by the canonical P_reference builder rather than inside the method
canonical probabilities are FP32 before the Arithmetic adapter copies them to FP64 for integer-width construction
author arithmetic computes its temperature softmax after promoting sorted logits to FP64
normalized special-token policy does not reproduce the author-only token-628 mask
